definitions.explanation: A part that swells out, or the roundness of something filled out: a bulge in a pocket, a bud about to open, a well-risen loaf. Also figuratively, the depth or richness of a story, a sound or a flavour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蕾|つぼみ}→蕾：04368_tsubomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{膨|ふく}らみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: The buds have begun to swell.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膨|ふく}らみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になった→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: The bulge in his pocket caught my attention.

notes:
The noun from ⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (to swell). Physical uses are neutral; the figurative sense (depth, richness) is common in reviews of books, music and wine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膨|ふく}らみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have fullness or depth
- {膨|ふく}らみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to give body or depth to
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膨|ふく}らみ: the swell of the chest
